summary: stui saves what is typed in a message box on the device as it is typed and brings it back when stui starts again, writes any panic and its backtrace to panics.log beside connection.log, and no longer panics when a pane is too short for its message box

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: No schema, operation or contract digest change. stui only.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

recovery.detail: stui keeps unsent drafts in drafts.json (owner-only, entries older than 30 days dropped) under its cache directory, never its state directory, so a paired device keeps no st state; deleting the file loses only unsent drafts.
